summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC, a London-based metal mining foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 17, 2026, attaching its Annual Report and Financial Statements for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. No special-situation event is disclosed. The filing recaps operational progress: funding secured, a NYSE American listing completed, appointment of non-executive directors Michael X. Schlumpberger and Mark Thorpe, and completion of the Pilot Mountain Pre-Feasibility Study. Advisers named include Cairn Financial Advisers as nominated adviser and Tamesis Partners plus Berenberg as brokers. No deal terms, stake, price, or premium are stated. Watch for future project financing or development announcements rather than arbitrage.
